featured_reviews.name: Shruti Ghurye
featured_reviews.review_text: Went here during the Covid pandemic to get a consultation from a GP as my family GP was not available. They directed me to Dr. G. R. Tripathi. My symptoms were a stuffy nose, itchy throat and slight weakness in the body which can be normal symptoms of common cold due to season change during monsoon. Dr. Tripathi didn't even check me but after just hearing the symptoms, he asked me to get a Chest X-ray and some blood tests- CBC and ESR immediately to check for pneumonicytis. He said that if there was pneumonicytis, then we can get a Covid test done. I asked him why can't I directly get a Covid test done to which he gave a vague answer that I will be unnecessarily quarantined. He gave me a prescription stating an antibiotic, a paracetamol, a vitamin C supplement and asked me to gargle with Betadine. I was still alarmed at his suggestion to get an X-ray and blood tests done. Then when I came to the billing counter, they charged me Rs. 800 just for getting a consultation from a GP. GPs normally charge not more than Rs. 400. I called my aunt who's also a GP to take a second opinion and she was alarmed too. With the symptoms that I had, it was absolutely unnecessary to go for an Xray and blood tests and a simple antibiotic would be okay. The main symptom of Covid is breathlessness. Would suggest no consulting such doctors who would go to any extent to loot people at the times of emergency.

featured_reviews.name: Shudhdodhan Ambhore
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review 20 days after the birth of our baby boy, delivered under the observation of Dr. Ashwini Tambolkar at Laxmi Maternity & Surgical Nursing Home, Kandivali East.

From the very first consultation till the day of discharge, our experience has been nothing less than wonderful. Dr. Ashwini is extremely kind, polite, understanding and supportive. She does not just treat her patients as “cases” but as human beings, with compassion and personal attention. My wife was very anxious about her second pregnancy and the need for a C-section, but under Dr. Ashwini’s guidance, care, and reassurance, the entire process turned into a smooth and happy experience. Both mother and baby are healthy and doing well today, and we are truly grateful for that.

The Mavshi staff and nursing team deserve special appreciation. No matter the time—day, midnight, or early morning—they were always available, attentive, and caring. Their skills, knowledge, and emotional support helped my wife recover quickly, especially during the first two days of post-delivery pain. They also took wonderful care of our baby, ensuring every little need was met.

Even my mother and mother-in-law expressed their gratitude, saying they had never seen such smooth and caring management of delivery compared to the difficult situations they had witnessed earlier in life.
Spending five days in the hospital felt like being with family. Despite staying one extra day beyond our package, the hospital did not charge us, which shows their genuine concern for patients over profits.

By the time of discharge, a strong bond had formed with the doctor, nurses, and mavshi staff. Even our elder son enjoyed his time there without missing school, thanks to the warmth of the hospital environment.

We are deeply thankful to Dr. Ashwini Tambolkar Ma’am, all the nursing staff, and the support team for giving us such a positive and memorable experience during this special phase of our life.

— Mr. & Mrs. Priyanka Shudhdodhan Ambhore
